query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, s.name as series_name, l.is_active as lesson_is_active, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, c.title as chapter_title, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id and e.is_active = false and e.is_published = false) as draft_exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercise_questions eq join public.exercises e on e.id = eq.exercise_id where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_question_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id and q.is_active = false and q.is_published = false) as draft_quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quiz_questions qq join public.quizzes q on q.id = qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_question_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where l.id in ('8f2b6cfa-d9e2-4a45-8417-cf97dd0bc393','6584c772-9985-4fd8-a7d0-6c6bfb54ae9b','2b4ed899-ce59-43d3-ae6d-998565afcabb','a5a2243a-31dd-40a5-b5ef-50a75e85756a','96a9192a-8892-42ed-90cd-07c1cccd49e3','562b5eb6-f323-41c7-8505-9e3a0f70ec2a','8503a5f0-3f0c-4826-af7a-86b57ee1e3ca','b0624f73-66ea-44e3-b0e0-f6d12dca47fa','d10a955a-d75c-464d-a067-5d257d7603bc','fc6e300b-ba2c-44c1-b015-f9c415d3e6cf') order by l.title, s.name limit 10;
